name: SF5 v-next.6 - Research + Critic + Cap + Audit + Claim + Isolation + Social Lane + Size Fact

main.node: Gmail - Audit Alert Draft (D4, NEVER SENDS)

parameters.content: SF5 - Research + Critic (Tavily). Picks the highest-fit scored companies not yet researched, searches each via the Tavily MCP server (standalone MCP Client node, generic MCP OAuth2 credential), extracts ONLY evidence-bound facts with an LLM, drops anything a strict critic cannot verify against the evidence, and saves artifacts/signals/people + a spend-ledger row. Marks the company researched. No outreach is created here.

parameters.query:
SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(cand ORDER BY fit_score DESC NULLS LAST, company_id ASC), '[]'::jsonb) AS candidates
FROM (
  SELECT c.id::text AS company_id, c.name, c.category, c.location, c.website, s.fit_score,
         EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM research_artifacts ra WHERE ra.company_id = c.id) AS has_research,
         false AS social_lane, NULL::text AS social_url
  FROM companies c
  JOIN scores s ON s.company_id = c.id AND s.search_profile_id = $1::uuid AND s.profile_version = $2
  WHERE c.status NOT IN ('approved','rejected')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.id::text AS company_id, c.name, c.category, c.location, c.website, NULL::numeric AS fit_score,
         EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM research_artifacts ra WHERE ra.company_id = c.id) AS has_research,
         true AS social_lane, c.raw_payload->>'social_url' AS social_url
  FROM companies c
  WHERE c.search_profile_id = $1::uuid AND c.profile_version = $2
    AND c.source = 'tavily_social' AND c.quarantine_reason = 'social_unverified'
    AND c.status NOT IN ('approved','rejected')
) cand

INSERT INTO selection_audit (run_id, workflow, company_id, rank, fit_score, cutoff, selection_reason, is_first_skipped)
SELECT x->>'run_id', x->>'workflow', x->>'company_id', NULLIF(x->>'rank', '')::int, (x->>'fit_score')::numeric, (x->>'cutoff')::numeric, x->>'selection_reason', (x->>'is_first_skipped')::boolean
FROM jsonb_array_elements($1::jsonb) x
ON CONFLICT (run_id, workflow, company_id) DO NOTHING
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost_usd), 0)::float AS spent_usd FROM cost_ledger WHERE run_id = $1
UPDATE companies SET research_claimed_at = now(), research_claim_run_id = $1 WHERE id = $2::uuid AND research_claimed_at IS NULL RETURNING id::text AS claimed_company_id

WITH p AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS j),
pack AS (INSERT INTO research_artifacts (company_id, field_name, value, source_url, raw_content, critic_verdict)
  SELECT (j->>'company_id')::uuid, 'research_pack', jsonb_build_object('summary', j->>'summary'), NULL, j->>'corpus', 'unchecked' FROM p RETURNING id),
fi AS (INSERT INTO research_artifacts (company_id, field_name, value, source_url, critic_verdict, quote_verified, quote_verified_at)
  SELECT (j->>'company_id')::uuid, x->>'field', x, x->>'evidence_url', 'supported', true, now() FROM p, jsonb_array_elements(j->'facts') x RETURNING id),
gf AS (INSERT INTO research_artifacts (company_id, field_name, value, source_url, critic_verdict, quote_verified, verification_failure)
  SELECT (j->>'company_id')::uuid, x->>'field', x, x->>'evidence_url', 'dropped_gate', false, x->>'verification_failure' FROM p, jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(j->'gate_failures', '[]'::jsonb)) x RETURNING id),
si AS (INSERT INTO signals (company_id, signal_type, detail, evidence_url)
  SELECT (j->>'company_id')::uuid, COALESCE(x->>'signal_type','other'), x->>'detail', x->>'evidence_url' FROM p, jsonb_array_elements(j->'signals') x RETURNING id),
pi AS (INSERT INTO people (company_id, full_name, title, source, raw_payload)
  SELECT (j->>'company_id')::uuid, x->>'full_name', x->>'title', 'tavily_research', x FROM p, jsonb_array_elements(j->'people') x RETURNING id),
sp AS (INSERT INTO spend_ledger (run_id, company_id, provider, action, credits)
  SELECT NULLIF(j->>'run_id','')::uuid, (j->>'company_id')::uuid, 'tavily', 'research_call', 1 FROM p RETURNING id),
pre AS (SELECT id, quarantine_reason AS was_reason FROM companies WHERE id = (SELECT (j->>'company_id')::uuid FROM p)),
up AS (UPDATE companies c SET status = 'researched',
  quarantined_at = CASE WHEN c.quarantine_reason = 'social_unverified' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements((SELECT j->'facts' FROM p)) f WHERE f->>'field' IN ('business_type','company_type','industry','category','business_description','description'))
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements((SELECT j->'facts' FROM p)) f WHERE f->>'field' IN ('address','headquarters','location')
                     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM search_profiles sp, jsonb_array_elements_text(sp.business_context->'locations') loc
                                 WHERE sp.id = c.search_profile_id AND sp.version = c.profile_version AND ((f->>'value') ILIKE '%' || loc || '%' OR (loc = 'Yangon' AND (f->>'value') ILIKE '%ရန်ကုန်%') OR (loc = 'Mandalay' AND (f->>'value') ILIKE '%မန္တလေး%') OR (loc = 'Bangkok' AND (f->>'value') ILIKE '%ဘန်ကောက်%')))) THEN NULL ELSE c.quarantined_at END,
  quarantine_reason = CASE WHEN c.quarantine_reason = 'social_unverified' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements((SELECT j->'facts' FROM p)) f WHERE f->>'field' IN ('business_type','company_type','industry','category','business_description','description'))
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements((SELECT j->'facts' FROM p)) f WHERE f->>'field' IN ('address','headquarters','location')
                     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM search_profiles sp, jsonb_array_elements_text(sp.business_context->'locations') loc
                                 WHERE sp.id = c.search_profile_id AND sp.version = c.profile_version AND ((f->>'value') ILIKE '%' || loc || '%' OR (loc = 'Yangon' AND (f->>'value') ILIKE '%ရန်ကုန်%') OR (loc = 'Mandalay' AND (f->>'value') ILIKE '%မန္တလေး%') OR (loc = 'Bangkok' AND (f->>'value') ILIKE '%ဘန်ကောက်%')))) THEN NULL ELSE c.quarantine_reason END
  WHERE c.id = (SELECT (j->>'company_id')::uuid FROM p) RETURNING id, quarantine_reason),
clt AS (INSERT INTO cost_ledger (run_id, workflow, provider, event_type, units, cost_usd, company_id, idempotency_key)
  SELECT NULLIF(j->>'run_id', ''), 'SF5 v-next.4', 'tavily', 'charge', 1, 0.008, (j->>'company_id')::uuid::text, 'sf5:tavily:' || COALESCE(NULLIF(j->>'run_id', ''), 'norun') || ':' || (j->>'company_id') FROM p ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING id),
cll AS (INSERT INTO cost_ledger (run_id, workflow, provider, event_type, units, cost_usd, company_id, idempotency_key)
  SELECT NULLIF(j->>'run_id', ''), 'SF5 v-next.4', 'llm', 'charge', 2, NULL, (j->>'company_id')::uuid::text, 'sf5:llm:' || COALESCE(NULLIF(j->>'run_id', ''), 'norun') || ':' || (j->>'company_id') FROM p ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING id)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM fi) AS facts_saved, (SELECT count(*) FROM si) AS signals_saved, (SELECT count(*) FROM pi) AS people_saved, (SELECT count(*) FROM gf) AS gate_dropped, (SELECT count(*) FROM clt) + (SELECT count(*) FROM cll) AS ledger_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM up u JOIN pre ON pre.id = u.id WHERE pre.was_reason = 'social_unverified' AND u.quarantine_reason IS NULL) AS released, (SELECT count(*) FROM companies pc WHERE pc.search_profile_id = (SELECT search_profile_id FROM companies WHERE id = (SELECT (j->>'company_id')::uuid FROM p)) AND pc.quarantine_reason = 'social_unverified' AND pc.status = 'researched') AS quarantined_parked
